items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: they were all with Lucky Millender

ctx.x: Who was on 'Ride Red Ride,' was that you?
I made 'Ride Red Ride,' but the first 'Ride Red Ride,' I think it was Panama; they were all with Lucky Millender.
But the LP, the one with Coleman Hawkins on it and Buster Bailey.
